iPad preview set

Use the actual iPad preview style across the site.

The official site now uses the iPad screenshot set prepared in the game project. The product visuals stay consistent, calmer, and closer to the real play experience.

One rule, many decisions.

TapMe.plus keeps the surface simple so every move is about target choice, merge position, and whether the next drop can continue the chain.

1

Tap to raise

Pick the tile that should become your merge target. The number increases by one immediately.

2

Merge connected matches

Three or more equal numbers connected horizontally or vertically collapse into the target tile.

3

Plan the chain

After a merge, tiles drop and refill. Strong moves leave the board ready for the next reaction.

Play without loading it here

Open the game only when you are ready to play.

The homepage does not embed the game runtime anymore. Click Play to open the dedicated web game in a new page, where the browser can download the Godot WebAssembly package intentionally.
